verdict.rationale: BigCommerce documents general REST/GraphQL APIs and a webhooks system that could plausibly carry order status/fulfillment events, but the evidence pack never cites specific order-status, fulfillment, or returns endpoints or webhook topics — only generic 'Use REST and GraphQL' and 'Webhooks' landing-page blurbs. Community evidence also flags unreliable API connectivity (throttling/dropped connections) as a caveat. Missing for 10: explicit docs for Orders API order-status/fulfillment/returns endpoints, webhook event types for order lifecycle, and any hands-on agent-driven order-management example.
